title: speeddial Module
content_markdown: This module provides on-server speed dial facilities. An user can store records consisting of pairs short numbers (2 digits) and SIP addresses into a table of OpenSIPS. Then it can dial the two digits whenever it wants to call the SIP address associated with them.
overview: This module provides on-server speed dial facilities. An user can store records consisting of pairs short numbers (2 digits) and SIP addresses into a table of OpenSIPS. Then it can dial the two digits whenever it wants to call the SIP address associated with them.

dependencies_required.name: database module (mysql, dbtext, ...)
dependencies_required.reason: must be loaded before this module

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: The URL of database where the table containing speed dial records.

exported_parameters.name: user_column
exported_parameters.description: The name of column storing the user name of the owner of the speed dial record.

exported_parameters.name: domain_column
exported_parameters.description: The name of column storing the domain of the owner of the speed dial record.

exported_parameters.name: sd_user_column
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column storing the user part of the short dial address.

exported_parameters.name: sd_domain_column
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column storing the domain of the short dial address.

exported_parameters.name: new_uri_column
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column containing the URI that will be use to replace the short dial URI.

exported_parameters.name: domain_prefix
exported_parameters.description: If the domain of the owner (From URI) starts with the value of this parameter, then it is stripped before performing the lookup of the short number.

exported_parameters.name: use_domain
exported_parameters.description: The parameter specifies wheter or not to use the domain when searching a speed dial record (0 - no domain, 1 - use domain from From URI, 2 - use both domains, from From URI and from request URI).

exported_functions.name: sd_lookup

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: The name of the table storing the speed dial records.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The SIP URI of the owner of short dialing codes. If not pressent, URI of From header is used.

exported_functions.description: The function lookups the short dial number from R-URI in 'table' and replaces the R-URI with associated address.
